    "cd3593ef: ;\n .;This routine is the MUMPS input transformer for the JAVABACKDOOR TEST file (#393).\n .;It handles editing of the STATUS CODE field (#10.08) as well as filing (cross-referencing)\n .;and retrieving data from this file.\n .;",
    "a889265d: ;Branch to the main entry point.",
    "a6c55e3f: ;Setup variables for editing.",
    "1c7097e5: ;If a value exists for the STATUS CODE field, store it in the array DE.",
    "52919185: ;Clean up module variables.",
    "40d77ad5: ;Write the prompt for the current field.",
    "74c8d1da: ;Placeholder for additional code.",
    "2565df80: ;Call DIR to perform I/O.",
    "0e48b178: ;If the field is longer than 19 characters and not word-wrapping, go to the word-wrapping utility.",
    "c787111d: ;If the field is read-only, set the value to null and display a message.",
    "918241c0: ;Read the user's input and handle timeouts.",
    "c40b1ee7: ;Placeholder for additional code.",
    "25da0891: ;Increment the loop counter for navigating between fields.",
    "e3320f07: ;Branch to the appropriate field processing code based on the loop counter.",
    "0be77f35: ;If a value exists for the current field, branch to restore it. Otherwise, read new input.",
    "b01b57e6: ;If X is blank and not required, branch accordingly.",
    "bed284df: ;If X is '?', go to HELP^XQ.",
    "df1d7abc: ;If X is '@', go to ENTRY POINT^DIE2.",
    "550892b1: ;If X is a space, DV is 'd', and there is a default value, set X to the default.",
    "6b51868a: ;Based on DV code, branch to the appropriate transform.",
    "e092fc5c: ;If no match found in the 'multiple', search for possible matches.",
    "457f7266: ;Write out the next segment of the multiple if no DQ array entry.",
    "90d08522: ;If DV is 'P', rescreen the value using the DIC reader and pointer review.",
    "ca6be2a6: ;Skip control and validate response if required.",
    "e059ea1e: ;If required and user response a number with decimal, massage it if necessary.",
    "2e98af5f: ;Transform the response.",
    "d842cc5e: ;Store the resulting response in the RESULT global and quit.",
    "8da91e27: ;Execution reaches here from DIEZPROG if invalid format response.",
    "6cb7baf4: ;Set error code.",
    "5c422397: ;Branch to QQ^DIEQ to determine reason X was terminated.",
    "8f2d7b73: ;Build the data string for the interactive loop",
    "dc322768: ;Do read if user response is not a null response",
    "2d5f5c34: ;Process the entry",
    "ea9782f0: ;Handle P-type X-ref",
    "b0e78c76: ;Handle V-type X-ref",
    "451ff92a: ;Handle S-type data",
    "52a3660c: ;Exit if null response and no data validator",
    "2851cad3: ;Branch to reader if input transform",
    "ca48839e: ;Call input transform",
    "42134451: ;(no comment needed)",
    "7a6dc189: ;Initialize variables",
    "76cfd2fc: ;Set field properties",
    "85b70d12: ;Set up DIC lookup",
    "25a3f29f: ;Enter reader",
    "b8ffd085: ;(no code)",
    "7e8183ec: ;If entering data on REVIEWED BY",
    "f4833662: ;If X is null then set REVIEWED BY to null, set DGJTST to SIGNED and go to X2",
    "21148e69: ;Quit",
    "719dbdb1: ;If entering data on REVIEW STATUS",
    "77d5c7c2: ;Set DGJTST to REVIEWED",
    "54d15555: ;Quit",
    "d744d21d:  .;\n .;Start of additional logic block\n .;DQ is set to 5",
    "16dd3604: ;If entering data on REVIEW STATUS CODE",
    "f9a5879d: ;Set DGJTST to the next entry in the REVIEW STATUS CODE file for the current value of DGJTST",
    "b818eb53: ;Quit",
    "388fcac6: ;Transfer control to routine DGJXA17"
  ]
}
